decision: Record CC BY 4.0 in place of the CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 declared in the Lexibank CLDF metadata.

evidence.from: Theraphan Luangthongkum (author of the source publication), private e-mail to Tiago Tresoldi
evidence.text: Yes, Tiago, and the dataset in Lexibank has the wrong license -- in fact, if you look at the source on JSEALS you can see it is just CC-BY-SA
evidence.note: Answer to Tiago Tresoldi's question about the license of the Lexibank dataset; the author also approved the correction to be made upstream in the next Lexibank release.

evidence.publication: Luangthongkum, Theraphan (2019). A View on Proto-Karen Phonology and Lexicon. Journal of the Southeast Asian Linguistics Society 12.1: i-lii.

evidence.from: Theraphan Luangthongkum (author of the source publication), private communication to Tiago Tresoldi
evidence.text: Confirmed that the licence is CC BY (Creative Commons Attribution), as stated in the JSEALS publication notice.
evidence.note: Asked to resolve the difference between the 2026-11-02 e-mail (CC BY-SA) and the journal notice (CC BY); recorded as relayed by Tiago Tresoldi.

assessment: The author confirmed CC BY, matching the JSEALS notice; the earlier mention of ShareAlike is superseded. NonCommercial and NoDerivatives never applied, so the upstream CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 declaration is an error, to be corrected in the next Lexibank release.
